text: City Council on December 13, 14 and 15, 2023, adopted Item TE9.83 and, in so doing, has requested the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority to waive any fees associated with the revenue loss from the Pay and Display Parking Machines, estimated at $44,100, as part of the 2023 Distillery Winter Village.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
